rule: Each frame is four single-colour 3-cell L-brackets marking a non-square box. In the output, all colour-1 cells outside every frame box are erased. Inside each box, the existing 1s are kept and their reflection about the box centre is added along the longer dimension: wide boxes use x' = l + r - x, tall boxes use y' = t + b - y. Brackets and background are unchanged.
scope: Separated same-colour L-bracket frames preserve and reflect their interior colour-1 patterns along the longer axis; stray 1 s outside all frame boxes are erased. Native scenes use 1..5 nonsquare frames on 5..30 sides, with one-half patterns and optional exterior blobs. Chosen frame count is fixed through retries; narrow packing can switch to a randomized tile constructor. All four canonical scenes are reconstructed from latent boxes and marker positions.

known_limitations: Background 0, marker 1, and one frame colour 2..9 are fixed roles in native scenes. Larger frame counts and dimensions are labelled extensions.
Default 2..4 frame target is clamped once to a conservative uniform 5 x 6/6 x 5 tiling capacity, not an exact maximum packing number. Explicit num_frames is honored or fails.
After 50 unsuccessful placement attempts, tiling retains frame count but can constrain orientations on a narrow canvas. Tile dimensions, selected cells, box sizes and positions vary.
Native patterns are on one side of the axis and their reflections are disjoint; crossing-axis and partially symmetric patterns remain possible through explicit scenes only.
Strays are absent if frames cover the canvas; after 50 failed fill attempts a one-cell/no-stray pattern fallback exists. It was not triggered in the 1240-pair audit.
Explicit scenes can contain more than 5 frames when num_frames is omitted, and output 1 s can exceed background 0. Background is identified from input.
Bounded generator/verifier agreement is not proof of all frame/episode identification cases.

authored_scope: Random scenes have grid sides 5..30. A side that is not given is sampled from a lower bound that depends on the frame count (12..26). Scenes hold 1..5 separated non-square frames, from 5x6 up to 10x20 (synthetic extensions beyond the fixtures), mixing wide and tall orientations. There is one frame colour from 2..9 per scene, background is 0 and the marker is 1. In-frame patterns are 1..3 clusters strictly inside one half of the interior, so every mirrored cell is new. Separate stray blobs of 1..4 cells lie outside every box. Deliberately not supported: square frames (no defined axis), touching or overlapping frames, multiple frame colours in one scene, 1s on frame border rows or columns in random scenes, patterns straddling the axis in random scenes, and non-zero backgrounds. Explicit scenes (width, height, colour, frames, ones) rebuild the canonical fixtures and accept any validated non-identity layout.
authored_constraints: Frame boxes are at least 5x5 and non-square; random frames are at least 5x6.
Frame boxes neither overlap nor touch (8-adjacency), so bracket pairing by nearest TR on the same row and nearest BL in the same column is unambiguous.
No 1 lies on a bracket cell; the bracket colour is never 0 or 1.
Random in-frame 1s lie strictly within the interior on one side of the long-axis centre line, so input != output.
Random stray blobs lie outside every box, are not 8-adjacent to one another, and have at most 4 cells each.
Background 0 is strictly the most frequent colour in the input (and, in random scenes, also in the output).
Explicit scenes must produce a non-identity pair and use int coordinates and colours.
All loops are bounded: 200 box-placement attempts and 60 fill attempts, with a final single-cell-per-frame fallback, then ValueError.
